recognize_zh: 左上角仍保留造血骨髓，其餘被纖維間質中大型多角形腫瘤細胞巢取代；中央細胞巢的細胞質濃稠嗜酸性、邊界清楚並有細胞間角化樣排列，是鱗狀分化的直接證據。
features: Residual hematopoietic marrow with erythroid and myeloid elements in the upper left corner
Cohesive nests of large polygonal cells with abundant dense glassy eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Central nest showing keratinizing, swirled eosinophilic material consistent with squamous differentiation
Pleomorphic oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Infiltrative smaller nests within desmoplastic stroma with scattered adipocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows residual hematopoietic marrow at the periphery of the field, with the remainder replaced by desmoplastic stroma containing infiltrative nests of large polygonal tumor cells. The tumor cells have abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct cell borders and pleomorphic nuclei with nucleoli, and the central nests show keratinization. The findings are consistent with metastatic keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and platelet-granular cytoplasm and lie singly or in loose clusters within hematopoietic marrow, not in desmoplastic stroma with keratinization.
Adenocarcinoma lacks keratinization and intercellular bridges and forms glands, and is p40/CK5/6 negative.
Epithelioid histiocytes have pale indistinct cytoplasm with slipper-shaped bland nuclei and are CD68-positive, cytokeratin-negative.
